gaps.sentence: The bonus made up ___ all the overtime we had done.
gaps.explanation: make up FOR something = compensate for it.

gaps.sentence: The caterpillar will turn ___ a butterfly.
I've mixed ___ the twins' names again.
gaps.explanation: mix up = confuse one thing/person with another.

gaps.sentence: Do you get ___ well with your new colleagues?
gaps.explanation: get on (with) = have a good relationship; also get along with (AmE).

gaps.sentence: Hurry ___ or we'll miss the ferry!
Police are looking ___ the cause of the crash.
Several runners passed ___ in the heat.
Put ___ your coat — it's freezing outside.
gaps.explanation: put on = dress in; put off = postpone.
